draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.39, the 29th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 2nd of 23 at DT. He went 19th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: John Randle. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (98th percentile), 40-yard dash (99th percentile). College production: his final season (2022) ranked 2nd in sacks among the 23 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. 29 career games and 28 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 6 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (12th percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 interior lineman who played: 2 pressures against a median of 4, below the norm.
